intent: To illustrate the demographic proportions of Sunni and Shia Muslims and the friction between these groups.

units.meaning: Sunni Muslims make up about 80% of the Muslim world.

basis.note: Table value is 80; narration frames it as about 80% of the Muslim world.

accepted_routes: Sunni Muslims make up about 80% of the Muslim world.
Sunnis are roughly 80% of Muslims.
The Sunni share is approximately 80 percent.
80% of the Muslim world is Sunni.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A Sunni-labeled mark must occupy about 80% of the whole, e.g. an 80% bar/area/slice or four-fifths of the composition.
units.temporal_anchor: The clause 'Sunnis make up about 80 % of the Muslim world'.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video state or visualize Sunni as 80% of the Muslim-world whole, or is a relative bar height enough?

units.meaning: Shia Muslims make up about 20% of the Muslim world.

basis.note: Table value is 20; narration frames it as about 20% of the Muslim world.

accepted_routes: Shia Muslims make up about 20% of the Muslim world.
Shia are roughly 20% of Muslims.
The Shia share is approximately 20 percent.
20% of the Muslim world is Shia.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A Shia-labeled mark must occupy about 20% of the whole, e.g. a 20% bar/area/slice or one-fifth of the composition.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video state or visualize Shia as 20% of the Muslim-world whole, or can it be shown only as the remainder?

units.meaning: Sunni Muslims are the larger group and Shia Muslims are the smaller group.

basis.note: 80 is greater than the Shia value of 20.
20 is less than the Sunni value of 80.

accepted_routes: Sunni are the larger group.
Sunnis outnumber Shia.
Sunni majority versus Shia minority.
Sunni share is higher than Shia share.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The Sunni visual element must be clearly larger or higher than the Shia visual element.
units.temporal_anchor: The two percentage clauses, or the opening framing of the proportions.
units.reviewer_question: Does the video need an explicit majority/larger-than label, or is the visible 80-versus-20 order sufficient?

units.meaning: The Sunni-to-Shia population ratio is about 4 to 1.
accepted_routes: Sunni are about four times as numerous as Shia.
The Sunni-to-Shia ratio is roughly 4 to 1.
For every Shia Muslim there are about four Sunni Muslims.
Sunni outnumber Shia by about 4 times.
units.visual_evidence_rule: If a ratio is shown, the annotation must compare the 80 and 20 values as 4:1, not 1:4.
units.temporal_anchor: Optional derived annotation after both percentage clauses; not stated in the original narration.
units.reviewer_question: Should the 4:1 ratio be required, or only allowed as optional derived context?

units.meaning: There is friction or tension between hardliners on both the Sunni and Shia sides.

basis.note: Qualitative friction from narration/intent; no table number.
Qualitative friction from narration/intent; no table number.

accepted_routes: Hardliners on both sides dislike each other.
There is tension between Sunni and Shia hardliners.
The two sects have friction among their hardliners.
Hardliners on both sides do not like each other very much.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A verbal or visual cue of tension/friction must appear between the two groups, while specifying hardliners rather than all Sunnis and all Shia.
units.temporal_anchor: The clause 'And the hardliners on both sides don't like each other very much.'
units.reviewer_question: Must the clip include a friction/tension cue between hardliners, or is that optional narration color?

optional_valid: The combined Sunni and Shia shares total 100% (80 + 20 = 100).
The Sunni-Shia gap is 60 percentage points (80 - 20 = 60).
Sunni share is four-fifths and Shia share is one-fifth.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal claims that the 80/20 split causes the friction between hardliners.
Extrapolating to global population, all people, or all Muslims beyond the stated Muslim-world denominator.
Claiming all Sunnis and all Shia dislike each other; narration specifies hardliners.
Inventing additional sects, countries, population counts, or historical causes.
Using the table's relative_value 1.0000 as if it were a percentage or share.
notes: The table supplies only the 80 and 20 values; all numeric units are direct uses or arithmetic combinations of those cells. Friction is qualitative from narration/intent and should be limited to hardliners, not all Muslims.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
